title: Hush Little Lamb

Disclaimer:

The purpose of this channel is to educate viewers on scripture and the word of God, while creating a relaxing environment to unwind. Videos on this channel are devotional pieces, featuring calm readings of scripture with original commentary, scriptural analysis and reflections throughout, offering unique insights and perspectives.

All media including video, artwork, footage, audio, music and narration is either original or appropriately licensed to ensure compliance with Youtube’s community guidelines and policies.
